status: FROZEN BEFORE EXECUTION. No result was computed before this file was written and committed.

hypothesis.basketball_mechanism: one decay rate cannot suit both stable and unstable roles
hypothesis.expected_direction: faster adaptation helps after role shifts and team changes; slow decay remains better for stable roles
hypothesis.supports_hypothesis: a GATED or DUAL-timescale variant beats alpha=0.10 in the unstable-role strata AND is non-inferior in the stable stratum
hypothesis.falsifies_or_weakens: no variant beats the incumbent anywhere, or gains vanish out of fold

incumbent.alpha_status: FROZEN. alpha=0.10 remains the registered incumbent regardless of what this workstream finds. Failure of the incumbent here would NOT establish that all decay rates fail, and success of a challenger here promotes nothing.
incumbent.decay_grain: per player APPEARANCE (not per calendar day): ew_x <- (1-alpha)*ew_x + x, ew_n <- (1-alpha)*ew_n + n

candidate_family.policy: SMALL, BASKETBALL-MOTIVATED, described in effective half-life / effective-window language. NOT a dense alpha sweep. The set below is CLOSED: no variant may be added, removed or retuned after any result is visible. No alpha may be read off a final aggregate and presented as confirmed.

variants.basketball_motivation: about half a WNBA regular season of memory
a full WNBA regular season of memory: 'this is who the player is'
roughly two to three weeks of games; can absorb a role change inside one road trip
dual timescale: half the estimate is who the player has been, half is what she is doing now. Weight fixed at 0.5 in advance, never fitted.

variants.form: rel_c = n_ewma_c / (n_ewma_c + K) for c in {fast=0.20, slow=0.05}; w_fast = rel_fast / (rel_fast + rel_slow); r = w_fast*r_fast + (1-w_fast)*r_slow; if rel_fast+rel_slow == 0 then w_fast = 0.5
variants.basketball_motivation: dual timescale where the short window earns weight only when the player's RECENT offensive exposure is itself well measured (a workhorse), and the long window carries a thin-minutes player. Formula fully specified in advance, nothing fitted.

variants.form: r = r_shrunk(alpha=0.20) if TRIGGER else r_shrunk(alpha=0.05)
variants.basketball_motivation: role-change-GATED decay: rapid adaptation activates ONLY on a documented projected or historical role shift; otherwise long memory. Memoryless switch.

variants.form: r = r_shrunk(alpha=0.20) if (TRIGGER or fast_mode_counter > 0) else r_shrunk(alpha=0.05); a fired TRIGGER sets fast_mode_counter = 10 and it decrements on each subsequent realised appearance
variants.basketball_motivation: the same gate with an adaptation PERIOD: after a documented shift the player is re-learned over the following ~10 appearances (about a quarter season) and then reverts to long memory

candidate_family.shrinkage: every variant is empirical-Bayes shrunk to the SAME prior-games league rate with the SAME K=200 offensive possessions, exactly as the incumbent. K is not varied in this workstream.
candidate_family.clipping: all rates clipped to [0,1] exactly as the incumbent
candidate_family.prediction: mu = rate * exposure, exactly as the incumbent

gate_trigger.definition: TRIGGER fires on a row iff ( role_shift_ws4 is not null AND |role_shift_ws4| >= 0.05 ) OR ( the player's team_id for this row differs from the team_id of her most recent PRIOR realised appearance )
gate_trigger.threshold_rationale: 0.05 of a ~200-minute team game is ~10 minutes per game, roughly a quarter of a starter's load. Chosen in basketball units BEFORE any error metric was computed. The feature's own distribution was inspected only for coverage sizing; no error, deviance or MAE was computed before this threshold was fixed.
gate_trigger.null_policy: role_shift_ws4 null (no trailing team-minutes history at all) does NOT fire the projected-shift half of the trigger. Such rows have essentially no long-memory state either, so the two timescales coincide there by construction. They are reported in the cold-start stratum.

role_shift_signal.why_not_the_p2_feature: BLOCKING LEAKAGE DEFECT in the canonical P2 artifact. experiments/player_program/turnover_p2_v1/turnover_role_context_features_v1.parquet builds trailing_minutes_share by iterating the REALISED box score (data/masters/master_player.parquet filtered to minutes.notna()) and left-merging onto the candidate universe. A Tier A candidate who did not appear therefore has no box-score row for that game and receives NULL. Verified: role_change.notna() equals did_appear EXACTLY (27,351 non-null == 27,351 appearers; 8,278 null == 8,278 non-appearers, zero off-diagonal). Using role_change as an operational gate would leak the appearance outcome perfectly. WS4 therefore rebuilds the signal.
role_shift_signal.reconstruction: identical EWMA state machine and identical constant (alpha = INVOLVE_ALPHA = 0.10 on minutes) as run_turnover_p2.py, but the state is READ for every Tier A candidate on that date rather than only for players who appear in that date's box score. State is advanced from realised box scores strictly AFTER all predictions for the date.
role_shift_signal.formula: trailing_minutes_share_ws4 = ewma_player_minutes / ewma_team_minutes (state strictly prior to the game date); role_shift_ws4 = proj_minutes_share - trailing_minutes_share_ws4
role_shift_signal.proj_minutes_share: projected_minutes / sum(projected_minutes) within (game_id, team_id) over the tier_a_only candidate set, from projected_exposure_v1 (cutoff-valid)

folds.policy: NESTED CHRONOLOGICAL DEVELOPMENT FOLDS ONLY. No shuffling, no random split, no unrestricted sweep, no out-of-time refit. Every prediction in every fold comes from one single left-to-right pass whose state contains strictly earlier games only, so fold k's history strictly contains fold k-1's history by construction.

burn_in.use: REPORTED but NEVER used for selection; the league prior is still forming

sign_convention.statement: delta = |error of INCUMBENT alpha=0.10| - |error of CHALLENGER|

uncertainty.method: percentile cluster bootstrap, clusters = game_id, 2000 resamples, seed 20260730, 90% interval

selection_rule.statement: A variant is DECLARED SUPERIOR to alpha=0.10 in a given stratum and track only if ALL FOUR hold:
conditions: C1 pooled paired improvement in that stratum > 0
C2 the 90% game-clustered bootstrap CI on that pooled paired improvement has low > 0
C3 the paired improvement is > 0 in at least 4 of the 5 nested chronological folds (2021 excluded)
C4 no single nested fold degrades by more than 50% of the magnitude of the pooled improvement
selection_rule.applied_identically_to: every variant, every stratum, both tracks
prohibited: reading an alpha off the final aggregate and presenting it as confirmed
adding, dropping or retuning a variant after any result is visible
selecting a stratum after seeing which stratum a variant happens to win

hypothesis_verdict_rule.SUPPORTED: a GATED (V6/V7) or DUAL (V4/V5) variant satisfies C1-C4 in the unstable_role stratum AND is non-inferior in stable_role (pooled improvement >= -0.002 turnovers per player row AND CI low >= -0.005)
hypothesis_verdict_rule.PARTIAL: a gated or dual variant satisfies C1-C4 in the unstable-role stratum but loses materially in stable_role, or wins only in one track
hypothesis_verdict_rule.NOT_SUPPORTED: no variant satisfies C1-C4 in any unstable stratum, or the gains do not hold across the nested folds

definitions.stable_role: |role_shift_ws4| < 0.02 AND no team change within the player's last 5 appearances AND prior career realised offensive possessions >= 500
definitions.post_team_change_5: the player's appearance index since her most recent team change is <= 5 (a first-ever appearance is not a team change)
definitions.post_trade_in_season: post_team_change_5 AND the change happened within the same season
definitions.offseason_team_change: post_team_change_5 AND the change happened across seasons
definitions.rookie_low_history: prior career realised offensive possessions < 200 (below K, so shrinkage dominates)

intrinsic.status: ORACLE DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Realised exposure is not knowable at the forecast cutoff. Never cite intrinsic numbers as operational performance.

operational.rows: all 35,629 Tier A candidate obligations including non-appearers

preservation.statement: Every variant in the closed set is scored and reported on every stratum in both tracks whether it wins, ties or loses. Nothing is dropped for losing.
